page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.xlarge is a compute-focused instance featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology, the server consists of 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory totals 8.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per vCPU. The processor cache configuration comprises 32 KB of L1d cache, 0.5 MB of L2 cache, and 16 MB of L3 cache. Supported hardware instruction set extensions include AVX, AES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. This instance type contains no bundled local SSD storage and zero GPU accelerators. Network connectivity operates at a baseline speed of 2 Gbps without included public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average single-threaded processing capabilities alongside lower multi-core execution throughput. Stress-ng testing yielded a single-core score of 767.9 and a multi-core score of 1535.77. Geekbench benchmarks registered 1305.0 for single-core and 2939.0 for multi-core performance. Uncached memory read bandwidth recorded 31.36 GB/sec, while write operations measured 16.16 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, single-threaded gzip compression reached 23.96 GB/sec, PassMark CPU encryption scored 4270.77, and Redis SET operations achieved 3.57 million operations per second.

The 1:2 memory ratio and absence of local storage require external network volumes for persistent data. Given the lower multi-core and memory bandwidth benchmark scores, the instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for lower-intensity dedicated compute operations rather than high-density parallel workloads. Suitable workload fits include lightweight web serving, microservices execution, basic background task processing, and low-concurrency software build jobs.
